Progressive Compression System — Generalized Linear B-Spline Wavelets with SPIHT Coder
definition: A compression system constructing a progressive bit stream from a hierarchy of subdivision wavelets, optimized for coarse to fine reconstruction.
summary: The Progressive Compression System compresses volumetric meshes using SPIHT and subdivision wavelets to create progressive bit streams for coarse-to-fine reconstruction.
